name: iOS/iPadOS device journey
description: How an iPhone or iPad was enrolled, the groups that resulted, and everything that reaches it.
note: Covers every enrolment route - Automated Device Enrolment, Apple Configurator, device enrolment, user enrolment and Company Portal. Where the device came through ADE, its token and enrolment profile are shown with expiry. VPP token expiry is always shown, because a lapsed token breaks app licensing silently. Devices managed by app protection policy alone are not enrolled in Intune and are out of scope.

fields.label: Device name or serial number, or two separated by a comma
fields.hint: One device to trace its journey, two to compare them. Exact match, case-insensitive. iPadOS devices are reported by Intune as iOS.

fields.label: Also write an interactive HTML report
fields.hint: A single self-contained file. Opens in any browser, works offline.
